flagged_for_reviewers.why_this_block_exists: These are the producer's OWN disclosures, surfaced here so no reviewer has to find them to know they matter. Recording them is not adopting them.
flagged_for_reviewers.F-1_negative_control_did_not_come_out_cl: The pre-registered mutation was caught on 1,808 of 1,822 inputs = 0.9923, NOT 1.0, with uncaught inputs in 10 of 20 configurations (worst 4 of 6 at point_add n=4, p=11). The producer's stated mechanism is that both swapped branches are gated on 'u odd AND v odd', so any trajectory never reaching that state makes the mutation a literal no-op. Recorded as D-1; no substitute mutation was run. THE GATE TALLY WAS BIT-IDENTICAL ACROSS THE MUTATION AT ALL 20 CONFIGURATIONS, reproducing KN-FIND-a4d4a4's mechanism in a structurally different circuit.
flagged_for_reviewers.F-2_the_width_axis_is_worse_and_was_repo: Peak and ancilla width are WORSE on the new side at 18 of 32 (n,p) pairs -- worse at EVERY pair n <= 11, mixed at 12 and 13, better only from about n = 14. Toffoli/T are better at 29 of 32. In the band n = 6..11 this is a genuine trade-off, not a win. The producer reported both axes rather than netting them, which is what DEC-20260813-5cef9c's axis-omission finding required.
flagged_for_reviewers.F-3_the_baseline_width_form_is_the_produ: Pre-registration clause 6.1 assumed a baseline peak_qubits at n = 256 that EV-QRE-45dfe1 DOES NOT CONTAIN -- the very omission DEC-20260813-5cef9c recorded. The producer derived n(b+w)+5n+5 itself and reports residual 0 at all 32 baseline pairs. Recorded as gap G-1. THE HEADLINE WIDTH RATIO AT n = 256 THEREFORE RESTS ON A FORM THE PRODUCER DERIVED, NOT ON FILED EVIDENCE, and a reviewer must check it before any comparison is cited.
flagged_for_reviewers.F-4_hamming_weight_dependence: Reported GONE on Toffoli, T, peak and ancilla -- functions of n alone, measured with two primes per width chosen for lowest and highest weight(p-2), bit-identical at all 16 widths while the baseline differs at every width. Reported to SURVIVE on CNOT/X, which the producer attributes to loading a classical constant rather than to the inversion algorithm.
flagged_for_reviewers.F-5_a_loose_count_against_its_own_constr: D-2: the comparison uses a full subtract-and-add-back rather than a MAJ-only comparator, so the reported count is loose AGAINST THE PRODUCER'S OWN construction. The variant was not built and no number is claimed for it.
